title: Q-ROOT-built-without-evidence: built-without-evidence keeps recurring: Set the row back until its live probe shows evidence.
body:
**Owner:** product
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe built-without-evidence
**Status:** open

Root cause class `built-without-evidence` recurred on 2 days (2026-11-25, 2026-11-26); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: state was written by the agent that wrote the code, not by a live reading
Guard: `grep:foundation/driftguard.py::def built_live`
Remedy: Set the row back until its live probe shows evidence.
Symptoms seen:
- failure-audit:dg-built-live: dg-built-live a knowledge-graph row is built but its probe answers no nodes x what-works: marked built, https://what-wor
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe built-without-evidence


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-26T16:04:17Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists
